texts.name: Ghuri
texts.biography: For decades, Ghuri protected the deepest roots and highest branches of the Tularean Forest. It was in these hidden heights that he earned the respect of the Green Dragons. His unique mastery of Forest Magic allows him to commune directly with these ancient creatures, bringing AvLee's most formidable guardians to fight under his banner.

specialty.name: Green Dragons
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Green Dragons or Gold Dragons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
